question: In which of the following areas did the Uprising of Khurda in 1817 take place?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Uprising of Khurda, also known as the Paika Rebellion, took place in the Khurda region of Odisha.
 
• It was led by Bakshi Jagabandhu Bidyadhar, the commander of the forces of the Raja of Khurda.
 
• The rebellion was a response to the British East India Company's oppressive policies and land revenue systems.
 
• The Paikas, the traditional warrior class of Odisha, played a significant role in the uprising, showcasing their valor and resistance against British colonial rule.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uprising of Khurda:**

 
 
• The Uprising of Khurda in 1817 is also known as the Paika Rebellion.
 
• The Paikas were the landed militia of Odisha, who were rendered landless by the policies of the British East India Company.
 
• The rebellion was one of the earliest organized armed rebellions against British rule in India.
 
• It was led by Bakshi Jagabandhu Bidyadhar, who mobilized the Paikas and other sections of society against the British.
 
• The revolt was primarily a reaction to the British land revenue policies, which were exploitative and led to widespread discontent among the peasants and landed gentry.
 
• The Paikas attacked British establishments, looted the treasury, and set fire to government buildings as a mark of their protest.
 
• Though the rebellion was eventually suppressed by the British, it is remembered for its significant impact on the resistance movements against colonial rule in India.
 
 
 
• **Odisha:**
 
 
• Odisha is an eastern state of India known for its rich history, culture, and heritage.
 
• The state was known as Kalinga in ancient times and has a long history of resistance against external invasions, including that of the Maurya Empire.
 
• Odisha is famous for its temples, such as the Jagannath Temple in Puri, which is a major pilgrimage site for Hindus.
 
• The state has a diverse cultural heritage, with various traditional dance forms like Odissi, folk music, and art.
 
• Economically, Odisha is known for its mineral resources and industries, including steel, aluminum, and power generation.
